name: Charge
effect: Move up to your speed, then attack one adjacent Monster.

name: Comeback Strike
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster. If you hit, you regain 2 hit points. If you miss, do not flip this card over.

name: Inspiring Advice
effect: Fighter utility power that inspires allies.

name: Into the Fray
effect: Fighter daily power for aggressive engagement.

name: One for the Team
effect: Fighter daily power focused on protecting allies.

name: Reaping Strike
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster twice. You punctuate your scything attacks with wicked jabs and small cutting blows that slip through your enemy's defenses.

name: Sure Strike
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster. You trade power for precision.

name: Taunting Advance
effect: Fighter at-will power for drawing enemy attention.

name: To Arms!
effect: Fighter utility power that rallies allies.

name: Astral Refuge
effect: Cleric utility power providing a protective refuge.

name: Blade Barrier
effect: Choose a tile within 2 tiles of you. Place five Blade Barrier tokens on five different squares on that tile. When a Monster is placed on a square with a Blade Barrier token, remove that token and deal 1 damage to the Monster.

name: Cause Fear
effect: Choose a tile within 1 tile of you. Each ally on that tile adjacent to a Monster can make an At-Will attack with a +2 bonus to the Attack roll. After the attacks, place each Monster remaining on a tile within 2 tiles of you.

name: Cleric's Shield
effect: Cleric utility power providing defensive shielding.

name: Command
effect: Cleric at-will power that commands enemies.

name: Healing Hymn
effect: Use this power during your Hero Phase. You and one other Hero on your tile regain 2 Hit Points. You sing a soothing song that seals the wounds of you and your allies.

name: Perseverance
effect: Cleric utility power providing endurance.

name: Righteous Advance
effect: Cleric at-will power combining attack with movement.

name: Sacred Flame
effect: Attack one Monster within 1 tile of you. If you hit, choose yourself or one Hero on your tile. That Hero gains 1 Hit Point. Sacred light shines from above, searing a single enemy with holy radiance.

name: Wrathful Thunder
effect: Cleric daily power dealing thunder damage.

name: Arcing Strike
effect: Paladin at-will power with sweeping attack.

name: Benign Transposition
effect: Paladin utility power that swaps positions with an ally.

name: Bravery
effect: Paladin utility power providing courage.

name: Divine Challenge
effect: Paladin at-will power that marks an enemy.

name: Holy Strike
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster. If you started your Hero Phase adjacent to the Monster, deal +1 damage if you hit. You strike an enemy, igniting it with holy light.

name: Lay on Hands
effect: Paladin utility power that heals an ally.

name: Noble Shield
effect: Paladin utility power providing defensive protection.

name: Righteous Smite
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster. Hit or Miss: All Heroes on your tile regain 1 Hit Point. Miss: 1 Damage. Your righteous attack fills your party with preternatural resolve.

name: Valiant Strike
effect: Attack one adjacent Monster. When making this attack, you get a +1 bonus to attack for each Monster adjacent to your Hero. The odds against you add strength to your attack.

name: Virtue's Touch
effect: Paladin daily power with healing touch.

name: Acrobatic Onslaught
effect: Rogue daily power with acrobatic attacks.

name: Distant Diversion
effect: Rogue utility power creating a distraction at range.

name: Distracting Jab
effect: Rogue at-will power that distracts enemies.

name: King's Castle
effect: Rogue utility power for repositioning.

name: Lucky Strike
effect: Rogue at-will power with lucky attack.

name: Positioning Shot
effect: Attack one Monster within 2 tiles of you. Hit or Miss: Place that Monster on any square on your tile or on an adjacent tile. To avoid your vicious attack, your enemy leaps exactly where you want it to be.

name: Practiced Evasion
effect: Rogue utility power for evasion.

name: Tornado Strike
effect: Attack four times. Each attack can be against any Monster on your tile. After the attacks, place your Hero on any square on your tile. Your weapon becomes a blur as you make swift, sweeping attacks.

name: Tumbling Escape
effect: Rogue utility power for escaping danger.

name: Arc Lightning
effect: Attack up to two Monsters. Each monster can be on your tile or any tile within 1 tile of you. Lightning leaps from your outstretched hands, blasting your foes.

name: Flaming Sphere
effect: Place 3 Flaming Sphere tokens in a stack on any square within 1 tile of you. Instead of moving during your Hero phase, you can move the Flaming Sphere stack 1 tile. At the end of your Hero Phase, you can remove 1 Flaming Sphere token and deal 1 damage to each Monster on that tile.

name: Hypnotism
effect: Wizard daily power that hypnotizes enemies.

name: Invisibility
effect: Wizard utility power granting invisibility.

name: Mirror Image
effect: Wizard utility power creating illusory duplicates for defense.

name: Ray of Frost
effect: Attack one Monster on your tile or on any tile within 2 tiles of you. A blistering ray of white frost streaks to your target, slowing its reactions.

name: Shock Sphere
effect: Wizard daily power creating an area of electrical damage.

name: Spectral Ram
effect: Wizard daily power that rams enemies with spectral force.

name: Wizard Eye
effect: Wizard utility power for scouting ahead.
